rules.title: Dockerfile Running as Root
rules.recommendation: Create and use a non-root user: RUN useradd -m appuser && USER appuser

rules.title: Dockerfile Missing USER Instruction
rules.description: Dockerfile has FROM but no USER instruction — container will run as root by default.
rules.recommendation: Add a USER instruction to run as non-root user.

rules.title: Using ADD Instead of COPY
rules.description: ADD can fetch remote URLs and auto-extract archives, increasing attack surface.
rules.recommendation: Use COPY for local files. Only use ADD for remote URLs or tar extraction.

rules.title: Using Latest Tag
rules.description: Using 'latest' tag can lead to unpredictable builds.

rules.title: Sensitive Data in ENV
rules.description: Secrets in ENV instructions are visible in image history.
rules.recommendation: Use Docker secrets, build args, or runtime environment variables.

rules.title: Exposing Sensitive Port
rules.description: Exposing database/admin ports increases attack surface.
rules.recommendation: Don't expose admin ports. Use docker networking.

rules.title: No HEALTHCHECK Instruction
rules.recommendation: Add HEALTHCHECK instruction for container monitoring.

rules.title: Privileged Container
rules.description: Privileged containers have full host access.
rules.recommendation: Use specific capabilities instead of privileged mode.

rules.title: Using Host Network
rules.description: Host network mode removes network isolation.

rules.title: No Multi-Stage Build
rules.description: Dockerfile uses only a single FROM — no multi-stage build.
rules.recommendation: Use multi-stage builds to reduce image size and attack surface.

rules.title: curl | bash Pattern
rules.description: Piping curl to shell can execute malicious code.

rules.title: AppArmor/Seccomp Disabled
rules.description: Disabling security profiles removes kernel-level protection.
rules.recommendation: Use default or custom security profiles.

rules.title: All Capabilities Added
rules.description: Adding all capabilities essentially gives root access.
rules.recommendation: Add only the specific capabilities needed.

rules.title: Host PID Namespace
rules.description: Access to host PID namespace can compromise the host.
